verdict.rationale: The Drive API exposes a `permissions` resource that can be created, listed, and deleted programmatically, letting developers set visibility (type: user/group/domain/anyone) and role (owner/writer/commenter/reader) — this covers the 'visibility' and 'revoke' parts of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of password-protected links or expiry settings being settable via the API, both of which are common Drive API permission fields but unevidenced here. Missing for 10: documentation of password-protected sharing links, documentation of expirationTime/expiry settings on permissions, and any independent/community confirmation of these two features working via API.
